newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah gains on dollar after polls.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah gains on dollar after polls.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah rose against the dollar at midday on Friday in response to general election results which were in line with market expectations, dealers said.
"It seems market players are comfortable with the election results," one U.S. bank dealer said.
President Suharto's ruling Golkar party has taken an unassailable lead, garnering over 73 percent of the 96 million votes counted by 0330 GMT out of a potential 125 million votes.
Spot rupiah rose to 2,435.5/36.5 at 0530 gmt from an opening of 2,441.00/43.00.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were quoted at 2,437.50/38.00 and 2,437.25/37.75 respectively.
The U.S. bank dealer said operators were unloading long-dollar positions established earlier to factor in possible social unrest during the election campaign.
He said outright selling also put pressure on the dollar. He said forward rates would have fallen much lower if the Thai swap market had remained steady on Friday.
"That's why our forward rates are limited on the downside," he said, adding that selling interest remained in the swap market.
The U.S. bank dealer said strong rupiah sentiment due to election results seemed to have outweighed reports of riots in the east Java island of Madura late on Thursday.
"There was some brief jitters but overall confidence seemed to have returned quickly. Offshore players retained their dollar-selling intrest," he said.
Overnight swap fell to -0.3 points on ample rupiah liquidity. tom/next swaps were at -0.2.-0.1. overnight money was traded 6.0 percent.
